basic_info.description: Welcome home to your mid-century modern haven perched on a secluded corner lot near the summit of Bernal Heights Hill. Move-in ready, this 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom single-family residence features stunning Bay views from two levels. Enter via the formal tiled foyer with custom cabinets & a wide staircase to the open floor plan where the living room, kitchen, and dining spaces flow together. To the rear, 2 bedrooms with built-out closets overlook garden.  The ground floor has been remodeled to include a versatile flex room or 3rd bedroom complete with beautiful wood custom cabinetry, bamboo floors, direct access to the backyard, and an en-suite bathroom featuring a walk-in shower, Laufen low-flow toilet, and red Vola faucet. Spacious 1-car garage with interior access, a laundry area, electric car charger, and ample hand-built shelving. See it before it's too late. Call listing agent for details.
